metadata.description: A collection of 31 custom Claude skills for product managers — covering discovery, strategy, execution, stakeholder communication, and analytics.

plugins.name: ab-test-planner
plugins.description: Design statistically rigorous A/B tests for product features, UI changes, and onboarding flows

plugins.name: ai-product-canvas
plugins.description: Structure AI/ML product decisions including model selection, data requirements, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI considerations

plugins.name: ambiguity-resolver
plugins.description: Turn vague opportunities and unclear briefs into structured, actionable problem statements

plugins.name: competitive-analysis
plugins.description: Research the competitive landscape — identify competitors, compare strengths and weaknesses, surface differentiation opportunities

plugins.name: competitive-intelligence-monitor
plugins.description: Monitor competitor signals and surface strategic insights from web, news, and product changes

plugins.name: competitor-pricing-change
plugins.description: Check competitor pricing pages for changes and flag anything that has shifted since the last snapshot

plugins.name: data-analysis-standard
plugins.description: Structure product data analyses with a clear question, methodology, finding, and recommended action

plugins.name: design-critique
plugins.description: Provide structured UX feedback using Nielsen's heuristics, Gestalt principles, and JTBD alignment

plugins.name: design-handoff-brief
plugins.description: Transform feature briefs into structured design briefs that give designers the user context and constraints they need

plugins.name: discovery-interview-guide
plugins.description: Create structured user discovery interview guides with screener questions, discussion guides, and synthesis frameworks

plugins.name: executive-update
plugins.description: Transform detailed product updates into concise executive briefings structured around decisions, risks, and numbers

plugins.name: experiment-designer
plugins.description: Design A/B tests from hypotheses and interpret results with statistical and practical significance

plugins.name: feature-prioritisation
plugins.description: Apply RICE, MoSCoW, Kano, ICE, or Opportunity Scoring frameworks to rank features and backlog items

plugins.name: job-application
plugins.description: Tailor a CV and cover letter to a specific job description with ATS optimisation and gap analysis

plugins.name: launch-readiness
plugins.description: Run a comprehensive pre-launch readiness assessment across product, engineering, marketing, support, and sales

plugins.name: multi-source-signal-synthesiser
plugins.description: Synthesise user signals from multiple research sources (interviews, support tickets, NPS, reviews) into a unified insight brief

plugins.name: okr-builder
plugins.description: Create well-structured Objectives and Key Results with quality checks and scoring guidance

plugins.name: performance-review
plugins.description: Transform notes into professional performance reviews with structured templates and clear framing

plugins.name: pm-weekly-review
plugins.description: Run a structured 20-minute weekly PM review covering metrics, shipping progress, blockers, and next priorities

plugins.name: prd-template
plugins.description: Write a complete Product Requirements Document from a problem statement or feature idea

plugins.name: pricing-strategy
plugins.description: Evaluate and design pricing models, tiers, and packaging using SaaS pricing frameworks

plugins.name: product-health-analysis
plugins.description: Assess overall product health across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and revenue metrics

plugins.name: product-strategy-critique
plugins.description: Play devil's advocate on a product strategy — identify gaps across target audience, problem definition, value prop, differentiation, growth, and monetisation

plugins.name: retention-analysis
plugins.description: Structure retention analyses including cohort breakdowns, churn root cause investigation, and improvement recommendations

plugins.name: roadmap-narrative
plugins.description: Transform a prioritised initiative list into a compelling strategic roadmap narrative for stakeholders

plugins.name: sql-query-explainer
plugins.description: Explain SQL queries in plain English and suggest optimisations

plugins.name: stakeholder-influence-mapper
plugins.description: Map stakeholder relationships, interests, and influence to inform alignment and communication strategy

plugins.name: stakeholder-update
plugins.description: Write targeted stakeholder updates tailored to audience, cadence, and communication goal

plugins.name: strategic-narrative-generator
plugins.description: Transform a list of product initiatives into a coherent strategic narrative for non-technical audiences

plugins.name: user-interview-synthesis
plugins.description: Synthesise user interview transcripts into structured themes, insights, and actionable recommendations

plugins.name: user-research-synthesis
plugins.description: Synthesise mixed-method user research into prioritised findings and product implications
